edges.description: All proposed edges. The first edge MUST describe the core processing mechanism (how the core category processes the object of study).

source.description: Label of the source node. For the first edge (core mechanism): the core node label.

target.description: Label of the target node. For the first edge (core mechanism): a description of what is being processed (the {object_of_study}).

description.description: Describe how these two nodes relate to each other. What is the nature of their connection? Use theoretical language grounded in the evidence.

rationale.description: Theoretical justification: why this relationship exists and what it explains about the {object_of_study}.

source_id.description: UUID of the hypothesis or conceptual_relationship.

summary.description: One-sentence summary of what the evidence shows.

quality.description: Describe the quality of this evidence source (e.g., multiple converging sources, single solid source, suggestive but limited).

evidence_quality.description: Overall assessment of evidence quality for this edge, considering all available sources and theoretical coherence.

processes_edge_present.description: MUST be true for a valid Database B. If false, the core mechanism is undefined.

processes_edge_missing_rationale.description: If processes_edge_present=false: why can't a credible core processing mechanism be constructed? What evidence is missing?

narrative.description: A 3-5 sentence narrative of the integrated model: what processes what, under what conditions, via what strategies, producing what consequences.

missing_evidence_notes.description: Plausible relationships that lack sufficient evidence. Methodological honesty: what edges would we propose if we had more data?

suggested_description.description: How would you describe the relationship if evidence were available? What is the hypothesized nature of the connection?

why_plausible.description: Why this relationship is theoretically plausible despite lacking evidence.

what_evidence_needed.description: What kind of data or incidents would be needed to establish this relationship.
